Maybe a small corner plaque "PASTURE // 06:42" with a monospace system stack for character. All visible, 4 legs each, recognizable. - Bounce animations out of phase. - Under 30 KB. - No console errors. Approach: use viewBox with preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" so the SVG scales. Actually CSS does apply to the shadow content cloned from , since the cloned tree inherits styles from the referenced element's computed style — the styles of the original element are used, and selectors matching original elements... The spec: for the `use` shadow tree, CSS selectors that match elements in the original tree apply? Actually CSS matching in the use-referenced content is done on the original element, so the referenced element and its descendants are matched against the selectors, and then the computed style is inherited into the clone. So `.leg{animation:...}` in the defs would apply to the cloned legs. But then all instances share the same animation timing, and per-instance phase offsets via class on the won't cascade.
